description:
Get a service integration by ID. Returns its type, source, destination, status, and user_config.

Call this before updating an integration and preserve its complete `user_config`. For `application_service_credential`, `user_config.exposed_values` contains `environment_variable_key` configuration, not the values injected into the destination application service.

The MCP schema currently describes `application_service_credential` in detail. Aiven supports other integration types too.
name: aiven_service_integration_get
title: Service Integration Get
